'''Taleah Novran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] [[Force Adept]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Novran attended the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] that was held in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the event, she tried to pair promising young Force Adepts with more experienced mentors, and three other Force Adepts: [[Otee Nom]], [[Dole Happ]] and [[Rilly Raadun]] assisted her in this task.

==Personality and traits==
Novran was strong-willed and was determined to succeed at her daunting task of finding and pairing up Force Adepts. She believed that all questions could be answered by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and thought that most [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]] were better suited by the minimum guidance approach of the Force Adepts than by the more rigid structures of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Rather than lecture her students, she would teach them through riddles and questions, hoping that this would lead them to discover their own paths to the Force.
